scope: First six reader essays in an open-ended Red Chamber series; Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and independently written English.

editorial.basis: Author-supplied papers 0–3: abstracts, relevant argument sections, source qualifications and conclusions. Paper 3's corrections take precedence over the overview on Guiyou provenance and borrowing.
editorial.voice: Public-facing essays in the author's first person, authorized by the request. New Chinese essays, not shortened paper sections. English independently written with background for readers unfamiliar with the novel. Traditional conversion reviewed and context-sensitive terms corrected.
distinctions: Events in the first eighty chapters versus the received forty-chapter continuation versus Han Qin's unpublished original chapters 81–110.
The project's interpretation and ethical choices are not presented as established historical authorial intentions.
A working hypothesis about the Guiyou version remains explicitly a working hypothesis; creative borrowing is not independent historical corroboration.
Different commentary hints can support different readings without proving that several complete lost manuscripts existed.
Calendar conjecture and withdrawal are reported from paper 2, not newly calculated here.
editorial.spoilers: Essays discuss the first eighty chapters, received endings and commentary, but do not disclose the original continuation's decisive rescues, turns or final destinations. Each article identifies its scope; paper links are collapsed and carry an explicit new-fiction spoiler warning.
editorial.preservation: 48 existing character essays and their catalog preserved byte-for-byte against the pre-hub baseline tested in test_hongloumeng_hub.py. No continuation chapters released. External source papers unchanged.
editorial.openness: Hub and article footers describe continued additions. Inventory derives from data, no fixed total in article numbering, no fabricated future chapter URLs.

extra: Same-essay cross-language navigation retaining section anchors
Explicit edition URL takes precedence over stored language preference

verification.discovery: 18 canonical URLs added; six records per language in EN/Hans/Hant. Unrelated search records and ordering preserved; no existing sitemap URL removed.
verification.limits: These are interpretive reader essays, not an independent authentication of contested manuscripts or a comprehensive critical-edition audit.
